# SCP-096's Abilities
This section describes the activated abilities available to SCP-096 and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General Information about Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
## Ability: "Emit a Pitiful Scream"
Activating this ability creates a powerful anomalous resonance, destroying surrounding structures with a sonic wave. This ability only functions inside the containment chamber's sound-proof walls. Use it to breach the containment chamber.
[textlink="More about Escape Methods" link="Scp096ContainmentBreach"]
## Ability: "Face Rip"
Activating this ability deals damage to your face, spraying blood everywhere. Using this ability 5 times in a row will deal critical damage to your face, putting you into the "Flayed Face State."
[textlink="Learn more about states" link="Scp096States"]
[bold]To activate this ability, you must stand still for a couple of seconds until the progress bar above your head runs out.[/bold]
This ability has a long cooldown, so make sure you do it right!
## "Sitting" Ability
Activating this ability puts you into the "Sitting" state. The subject changes appearance and becomes unable to move. In this state, the shy one secretes tears more frequently.
In general, this status carries no practical significance; you may utilize it at any time.
## Safe Time Mechanics
For the first 15 minutes of the round, you are unable to use your "Face Rip" ability.
This mechanic restricts SCP entities during the early stages of the round, granting the facility staff time to complete their initial preparations for the shift.
## Vision Mechanics
The game features a unique system that determines whether one character is visible to another.
[bold]If you and another individual make direct eye contact, you will enter a "Pre-Rage" state, followed shortly thereafter by a "Rage" state.[/bold] The person who spotted you will become a valid target — one that you can then eliminate with ease. You will gain the ability to demolish blast doors, windoors, and all types of airlocks. Your tunnel vision will make it so the only living thing you can see is your target.
